The mesh pocket is perfect for holding smaller accessories, and an integrated play stand lets you enjoy tabletop mode with ease. When the system is inside the case, the play stand acts as a padded screen protector. Works with Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch - OLED Model. Backed by a 2-year limited warranty. *Nintendo Switch 2 system, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch – OLED Model, Game Cards, Joy-Con 2 wrist straps and other accessories not included.
